description: Client-side script for POS Closing Entry form in ERPNext, handling form events, data fetching, calculations, and UI updates.

methods.name: set_form_data
methods.description: Populates POS transaction data into the form and updates totals.

methods.name: add_to_pos_transaction
methods.description: Adds a POS invoice record to the transactions list in the form.

methods.name: refresh_payments
methods.description: Updates payment reconciliation entries based on POS invoice payments.

methods.name: refresh_taxes
methods.description: Updates tax entries based on POS invoice taxes.

methods.name: reset_values
methods.description: Resets transaction, payment, tax totals and lists in the form.

methods.name: refresh_fields
methods.description: Refreshes UI fields for transactions, payments, taxes, and totals.

methods.name: set_html_data
methods.description: Fetches and displays payment reconciliation details if form is submitted.
